svg.text: NVIDIA Collective Communications Library - github.com/NVIDIA/nccl - topology-aware GPU collectives
L1 - Framework Integration + Workloads (standard CCL backend for NVIDIA multi-GPU / multi-node)
L2 - Programming Model (ncclComm_t - host-launched bulk-synchronous collectives - channel parallelism)
Host enqueues collectives on CUDA streams
Bulk sync before/after comm phases - stop-and-go
Per-GPU parallel pathways bound to SMs
Ring or double-tree topology per channel
Launch once - reuse across many collectives
L3 - Topology Discovery + Graph Search (auto-detect hardware - compute optimal comm graphs)
Graph: GPU CPU NIC switch PCIe NVSwitch
Bandwidth = min link bw - path type = worst hop
P2P reroute - GDR - PXN proxy GPU paths
Ring - high bw large messages - O(n) steps
Tree/NVLSTree - low latency small messages O(log n)
Simple - LL - LL128 protocols by msg size
Tuner plugin API overrides cost model hints
Dynamic CTA count + chunk size scheduling
L4 - Communication Pipeline (group batching - task schedule - kernel plan - device execution)
Enqueue work items per channel per rank
CPU proxy thread for NET/CollNet async I/O
Progress isend/irecv while GPU kernels run
L5 - Transport Layer (intra-node P2P/SHM - inter-node NET/CollNet - NVLS multicast)
IB RoCE TCP via ncclNet_t plugin
L6 - Source Layout + Infra (src/graph/ - transport/ - device/ - plugin/ - bootstrap/ - RAS)
AllReduce Ring Execution Path (large message bandwidth mode)
Init topology - build ring per channel - chunk data - persistent kernel - n-1 reduce-scatter + n-1 allgather steps
Step 1: ncclCommInitRank - bootstrap - ncclTopoGetSystem - BFS paths - graph search
Step 2: ncclTopoTuneModel picks Ring + Simple protocol + N channels for message size
Step 3: Setup P2P/NVLink intra-node + NET IB inter-node connections per channel
Step 4: ncclAllReduce enqueues - chunk slices to channels - launch persistent ring kernel
Step 5: GPU sends recv chunks ring-wise - proxy progresses NET async - stream sync at end
Small msgs: auto-switch to Tree + LL/LL128 for lower latency - operator-level overlap only
Cross-DC: fabricId minimizes inter-DC hops - multi-NIC scatter for heterogeneous networks
NVLS/CollNet: hardware offload path bypasses ring for AllReduce on NVSwitch/SHARP systems
De-facto NVIDIA multi-GPU CCL - auto topology tuning - plugin-extensible network stack
ncclCommInitRank + ncclAllReduce(buf, count, dtype, op, comm, stream)
Design Position (topology-aware auto-tuned collectives - industry default for NVIDIA distributed training)
Graph search + channel parallelism + plugin transports + HW offload = out-of-box peak GPU-GPU bandwidth
Init: uniqueId bootstrap - topo discovery - path BFS - graph search - connection setup - channel config
Loop: enqueue collective - tune algo/proto - plan kernel - transport xfer - proxy NET - stream sync
Sources: github.com/NVIDIA/nccl - docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/nccl - NVIDIA NCCL tuning blog - arXiv 2507.04786
